name: indexer-paging
description: Paging of /blockchain/box/unspent/byAddress with and without includeUnconfirmed, on two indexing nodes (X on this role's jar, Y on the other's) that hold 5 confirmed and 3 mempool boxes at one address: every page at most `limit` boxes, and consecutive pages equal to the one-page listing with no box twice; the one-page listings equal across the jars. Written for ergoplatform/ergo#2538 (offset and limit applied after confirmed and mempool boxes are combined).
